## Verification

- [ ] `python3 scripts/run_checks.py` passes.
- [ ] Public examples and fixtures contain no restricted research material.
- [ ] User-visible changes are recorded in `CHANGELOG.md`.
- [ ] Third-party sources, revisions, licenses, and notices are updated when applicable.
- [ ] State-schema changes are backward readable or include a tested migration.
- [ ] New or changed record formats update `schemas.json` and use distinct input/report identifiers.
